tableSchema.notes: Data Set with Voting Records of Greenlandic and Faroese MPs in Folketinget

columns.name: ballot_id
columns.dc:title: Ballot ID
columns.dc:description: ID assigned to the ballot in Folketinget records

columns.name: MP_id
columns.dc:title: MP ID
columns.dc:description: Folketinget ODA ID assigned to the MP

columns.name: surname
columns.dc:title: Surname(s)
columns.dc:description: Surname(s) of the MP

columns.name: party
columns.dc:title: Party
columns.dc:description: Political Party the MP is member of

columns.name: gvt_party_at_home
columns.dc:title: Governing Party at Home
columns.dc:description: Boolean indicating if the party the MP belongs to is part of the governing coalition in Greenland or Faroe Islands at the time of the vote.

columns.name: vote_type_id
columns.dc:title: Vote Type ID
columns.dc:description: Folketinget ODA ID assigned to the vote type.

columns.name: vote_id
columns.dc:title: Vote ID
columns.dc:description: Folketinget ODA ID assigned to the vote.

columns.name: ballot_pass
columns.dc:title: Ballot Pass
columns.dc:description: Boolean indicating if the ballot passed.

columns.name: ft_process_step
columns.dc:title: Folketinget Process Step
columns.dc:description: Stage of the parliamentary process the ballot is part of

columns.name: ft_topic_id
columns.dc:title: Topic ID
columns.dc:description: Folketinget ODA ID assigned to the parliamentary process the ballot is part of

columns.name: ft_topic
columns.dc:title: Ballot Topic
columns.dc:description: Description of the topic the proposal on the ballot is about

columns.name: ft_for
columns.dc:title: For Votes
columns.dc:description: Number of votes in favor of the proposal.

columns.name: ft_against
columns.dc:title: Against Votes
columns.dc:description: Number of votes against the proposal.

columns.name: ft_abstention
columns.dc:title: Abstention Votes
columns.dc:description: Number of abstention votes.

columns.name: ft_absent
columns.dc:title: Absent Votes
columns.dc:description: Number of absent MPs.

columns.name: ballot_date
columns.dc:title: Ballot Date
columns.dc:description: Date of the ballot.

columns.name: ballot_type_id
columns.dc:title: Ballot Type ID
columns.dc:description: ID assigned to the ballot type.

columns.name: gvt_type_dk
columns.dc:title: Type of Government in Denmark
columns.dc:description: Indicates the type of cabinet governing in Denmark at the time of observation

columns.name: gvt_bloc_dk
columns.dc:title: Political Bloc of the Danish Government
columns.dc:description: Indicates the political bloc of the cabinet governing in Denmark at the time of observation (red/left, blue/right or across)

columns.name: comment
columns.dc:title: Comment
columns.dc:description: Additional comments about the ballot.

columns.name: ballot_result_string
columns.dc:title: Ballot Result String
columns.dc:description: String describing the ballot result.
